sample_unit: predictions (239 ICU admissions, 3 sequential vancomycin troughs each)

links.outcome: Comparison of two LLMs on vancomycin trough and dosing interval prediction accuracy
links.effect: ChatGPT outperformed Grok for trough (MAE 4.07 vs 5.08 mg/L; ±2 mg/L accuracy 37.0% vs 29.0%); Grok better for interval (MAE 1.36 vs 1.61 h). Neither compared with pharmacist TDM.
links.quote: ChatGPT outperformed Grok in trough prediction (MAE 4.07 vs 5.08 mg/L; RMSE 5.55 vs 7.53 mg/L; ±2 mg/L accuracy 37.0% vs 29.0%), with greater advantage at T1/T2 and in renal dysfunction.

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark comparing ChatGPT and Grok for predicting vancomycin trough levels and dosing intervals using the MIMIC-IV dataset without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
